title: The Cotique bugaloo album
summary: He signed with George Goldner's Cotique, but little came of the album because the label favored young artists.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: All right. Then what prompted you to record that bugaloo album for Cotique?
Because we signed with Cotique with George Goldner and then he was a good marketing man. He had that knack that he know what the people would like.
Did that album do anything for the band?

I don't know, I don't think nothing happened because he was more entuthiastic with the young ones and there was too many young guys in the company that we might create problem with the rest of the artists.
